requirement: Voice input: the chat box's microphone writes live words into the draft through tracy-web's speech relay, which enforces origin, session, one session per account, time, silence and minute limits

oracle.ref: PR #1364 (feat); fix evidence: 15/10/2026: speech to text in the chat box like Claude Design, live, in the language spoken (ElevenLabs Scribe). Live measurement and screenshots: tasks/evidence/voice-input-2026-10-15/.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures (the one live-service test is skipped without VOICE_E2E_REAL=1). 'dictation: words appear live in the draft, the language heard is shown, Done keeps them' passes: the draft reads 'Please: Đổi màu nền' mid-sentence, the badge reads VI, Done sends nothing. 'Enter while speaking: the last phrase is confirmed, then the message is sent once' passes. 'Escape takes the dictated words back out; the draft is as it was' and 'typing while speaking takes the draft back…' pass. 'a handshake is refused without a key (404), from another origin or site (403), and without a session (401)' passes, and nothing refused reaches the service. 'the first minute is counted before the service is called; over today’s budget, it never is' and 'a session ends after five minutes of audio (time-limit)…' pass. 'a page that is not a secure context (plain http): no microphone, since the browser offers none' passes. 'a phrase the service sends twice is told once, in either order; its copy only names the language' and 'a late copy of a finished phrase sent as a partial is dropped, so the phrase is never written twice' pass: the live service's order (stamped copy first) and its late partial never write a phrase twice.
